sub: Converts videos to .nfv (v4: picture and sound in one file) in the browser, no PC program needed, and writes them straight to the device's SD.
drop:
Drag your videos here — or click to pick them
mp4 · mov · webm · mkv · avi … conversion runs locally in the browser (ffmpeg.wasm)
turbo: A whole film? The PC is much faster: python tools/nfv/nfv4.py film.mkv, then node tools/nfv/push-resume.mjs to copy it to the SD. Same format (.nfv v4), same normalised audio.
err_not_video: not a video file — pick an mp4, mov, mkv, webm or avi
err_frame_big: frame too large for the device: use the Compact profile
